caption: The drawing contains six rectangular swatches arranged in three rows and two columns on a beige background. The top-left swatch features a pattern of horizontal stripes in shades of blue and gray, with small blue geometric accents along the top. The top-right swatch displays a red background with a floral pattern composed of dark green leaves, black flower outlines, and fine black dots scattered throughout. The middle-left swatch shows a brown background filled with a dense pattern of angular lightning-bolt shapes in white. The middle-right swatch presents a white base with blue hatch-marked backgrounds and large, black floral patterns in a repeated arrangement. The bottom-left swatch is patterned with alternating solid black and dotted lines forming horizontal rows, creating a rhythmic stripe effect on a light background. The bottom-right swatch has a solid black background with small, scattered floral motifs in white, pink, and green, as well as some tiny yellow dots.
title: Quilt Patches
